name: PADM-23/APAYO
what_it_holds: Hackathon (Junction Asia 2026) iOS medical-intake app for migrant seasonal farm workers in Gyeongsangbuk-do, South Korea. Bundles ~3,415 clinic and 1,141 pharmacy locations from Korea's Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service open data, used only for facility lookup inside the app — no worker counts, arrival dates, or travel-demand data.
why_useful: Checked because it combines 'medical' and 'seasonal migrant worker' in scope; contains no time series or volume data relevant to travel demand, only a static facility list for a single Korean province. Included for completeness/negative result.
